references.text: The description of the altar of incense and its carrying poles, which is the same altar mentioned in Exodus 35:15
The recipe for the anointing oil mentioned in Exodus 35:15
The recipe for the fragrant incense mentioned in Exodus 35:15
The instructions for the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle, corresponding to the curtain mentioned in Exodus 35:15
The actual execution of the altar of incense, the anointing oil, and the incense that was planned in Exodus 35:15
Moses is instructed to set up the gold altar for incense before the ark of the testimony
Moses sets up the altar of incense and burns fragrant incense on it
The Letter to the Hebrews mentions the gold altar for incense as part of the holy furnishings of the tabernacle
Revelation describes incense rising from a golden altar, symbolically linking it to the altar of incense in the tabernacle
The connection shows the transition from God's command to make holy items to their actual completion and delivery.
The link emphasizes the consistency in God's requirements: the same holy elements (oil and incense) are central both in the instructions and in their execution.
